newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Asustek to issue T$15/share dividend.
newsitem.headline: Asustek to issue T$15/share dividend.

text.p: Taiwan's Asustek Computer Inc, one of the island's leading computer motherboard makers, said on Friday its shareholders' meeting has approved a stock dividend of T$15 per share for 1996.
The T$15 dividend is the highest so far of all Taiwan's listed firms for 1996.
Its shareholders also approved a plan to launch 50 million shares in a rights issue to be used as global depositary receipts in raising funds abroad.
"We hope the GDR issue can raise some US$200 million for our expansion to produce motherboards and notebook computers," a company spokeswoman told Reuters.
"But we have yet to set a timing for the GDR issue."
Asustek made a 1996 pre-tax profit of T$4.07 billion on sales of T$13.33 billion, up sharply from a 1995 pre-tax of T$2.057 billion on sales of T$7.873 billion, she said.
It has yet to make forecasts for its 1997 performance, she said.
Dubbed as "king share," Asustek's share price, T$686 at Thursday's closing, was the highest in the market.
Since its debut listing in November 1996, its share price has hit a T$762 high, up sharply from its debut price of T$108.
In early Friday trade, Asustek rose T$14 to T$700.
